# Support

## What to include in a bug report

- library version (`1.8.0` or later)
- platform/compiler details
- whether the failure happened in parse, decode, encode, or release tooling
- minimal reproducer or sample file, if possible

## Security issues

Please follow `SECURITY.md` instead of filing a public issue for an exploitable parser bug or secret-handling problem.

## Governance issues

If a ruleset, merge queue, or immutable release policy blocks valid work, include the exact GitHub check or ruleset name in the report.
